description: Reads US public company financials from SEC EDGAR XBRL. Company mode returns one company's reported history of a metric (revenue, net income, assets and 20 more, or any us-gaap tag) by ticker or CIK. Screen mode ranks every filer on one metric for one calendar period. Every figure carries period_type and a link to its filing. Reports figures, not advice.

company.description: Company mode: ticker or CIK number.

metric.description: A name such as revenue, net_income, gross_profit, operating_income, rd_expense, sga_expense, interest_expense, income_tax, or a raw us-gaap tag like Revenues. Default revenue.

min_value.description: Lowest value to keep. Negatives are legal.

mode.description: screen ranks all companies for one period; company gives one company's history. Defaults to company when company is set, else screen.

order.description: desc by default: largest value first in screen mode, newest period first in company mode.

period.description: Screen mode: CY2023 or CY2023Q1 (calendar year, optional quarter). Default CY2024.

period_type.description: Keep only quarterly, half_year, nine_month, annual or instant figures. Default any.

name: sec_financials
title: SEC financials and screener
